title: Haaye Zainab Ka Asra Ghazi
body:
Haaye Zainab ka aasra ghazi..
Beta kehti hai fatema ghazi.
Haaye zainab ki geer gayi chadar..
Mar gaya tu Ye Jab suna ghazi..
Sar se chadar ko loot kar zalim..
Hass ke kehta hai ab bula ghazi..
Bole sajjad ay phuphi amma..
Tukde tukde mujhe mila ghazi..
Hath kaate hai sar bhi kaata hai.
Tukde tukde badan hua ghazi..
Laut aawo sakina kehti hai..
Paani magungi Na chacha ghazi..
Waqte zibha hussain ke lab ne..
Naam tera hi bas liya Ghazi..
Shimr bachhi ko mar kar bola..
Aayega na Tera chacha ghazi..
Kaise Asmee Sumair ho Ye BayaN...
Misle Qasim tu Bat Gaya Ghazi..
